verdict.rationale: Appwrite explicitly supports SDK-based development with 'SDK methods' triggering Functions, a CLI 'generate' command that creates type-safe SDKs from project schema, and dedicated AI-native tooling (MCP server for 'SDK-accurate calls', Skills markdown files, docs-as-markdown, llms.txt) that teaches agents to use its SDKs correctly. This shows first-party investment in making SDKs agent-buildable, though the pack lacks an explicit enumerated list of supported SDK languages or independent hands-on validation of SDK quality. Missing for 10: explicit list/count of official SDK languages, independent developer corroboration of SDK reliability.
